result.markdown:
# RRC Failure Rate Spike Caused by Bad Configuration Change

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-SAH-006`
- **Confidence:** medium (Timing fits KPI onset perfectly, direct change and alarm evidence exist, and maintenance was checked via T5.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-20 01:30 to 2026-09-20 07:06
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-20 01:31
- **Affected:** S-SAH-006, S-SAH-001, S-SAH-009

## Summary

Pushing RAN parameter template OPT-17 caused severe RRC success degradation and drop rate spikes on S-SAH-006 and sibling sites.

Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose across S-SAH-006, S-SAH-001, and S-SAH-009 for 5.5 hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-20 01:30: Anomaly detected: RRC success drops and drop rate spikes on three sites. [ALR-0029]
- 2026-09-20 01:31: Parameter template OPT-17 pushed to S-SAH-006. [CHG-2026-0062]
- 2026-09-20 01:57: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-SAH-006. [ALM-000436]
- 2026-09-20 06:58: Rollback of parameter change executed on S-SAH-006. [CHG-2026-0067]
- 2026-09-20 07:04: RRC failure rate alarm cleared on S-SAH-006. [ALM-000436]

## Evidence

- S-SAH-006 experienced a drop rate spike and RRC success percentage drop starting around 01:30. [ANM-000360, ANM-000361]
- RAN parameter template OPT-17 was pushed to S-SAH-006 at 01:31. [CHG-2026-0062]
- Minor RRC failure rate alarm on S-SAH-006 cleared at 07:04 following the rollback. [ALM-000436]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected nodes during the incident. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-SAH-006: confirmed. Change CHG-2026-0062 closely preceded the KPI degradation, and rolling it back restored KPIs. [CHG-2026-0062, CHG-2026-0067]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SAH-02-B: rejected. No major or critical alarms found on transport links or aggregation routers. [T3]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000427: VSWR high alarm on S-SAH-001 cleared before the incident window started.
- ALM-000429: VSWR high alarm on S-SAH-001 cleared long before the incident occurred.

## Recommended actions

- Verify admission control and RRC timer configurations in template OPT-17 before future deployments.
- Perform post-implementation reviews for all RAN parameter pushes.

## Sources

- `ALR-0029`: ended alert from 2026-09-20 01:30: 3 site(s) (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-006, S-SAH-009); region-level SAH; metrics: drop_rate_pct, rrc_success_pct
- `CHG-2026-0062`: parameter_tuning on S-SAH-006 at 2026-09-20 01:31: Push RAN parameter template OPT-17 to S-SAH-006 (admission control, RRC timers) [ROLLED BACK by CHG-2026-0067 at 2026-09-20 06:58]
- `ALM-000436`: minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH on S-SAH-006, raised 2026-09-20 01:57, cleared 2026-09-20 07:04
- `CHG-2026-0067`: rollback of CHG-2026-0062 on S-SAH-006 at 2026-09-20 06:58: Rollback of OPT-17 on S-SAH-006 after KPI regression escalated by NOC
- `ANM-000360`: S-SAH-006 drop_rate_pct spike, z 12.8, baseline 0.58 -> 2.58
- `ANM-000361`: S-SAH-006 rrc_success_pct drop, z -23.3, baseline 99.4 -> 96.2
- `T5`: get_maintenance(start=2026-09-19 18:00, end=2026-09-20 09:01, node_ids=['S-SAH-006', 'S-SAH-001', 'S-SAH-009', 'AGG-SAH-02', 'LNK-SAH-02-B'], include_ -> No maintenance window scheduled on S-SAH-006, S-SAH-001, S-SAH-009, AGG-SAH-02 +1 more and its parents between 2026-09-19 18:00 and 2026-09-20 09:01.
- `T3`: get_alarms(start=2026-09-19 18:00, end=2026-09-20 09:01, node_ids=['S-SAH-006', 'S-SAH-001', 'S-SAH-009', 'AGG-SAH-02', 'LNK-SAH-02-B'], include_desce -> 5 alarm(s) on S-SAH-006, S-SAH-001, S-SAH-009, AGG-SAH-02 +1 more and nodes below: 5 minor; 0 active. None critical/major.
- `ALM-000427`: minor VSWR_HIGH on S-SAH-001, raised 2026-09-19 17:59, cleared 2026-09-19 18:18
- `ALM-000429`: minor VSWR_HIGH on S-SAH-001, raised 2026-09-19 18:32, cleared 2026-09-19 18:44
